verdict.rationale: Sill is a Mac-to-iPhone/iPad screen-streaming and remote-control app, so scheduling user-defined recurring jobs or workflows falls outside its product category. The recurring items in the evidence do not change this: the once-a-day update check is internal app behavior, the nightly builds are the vendor's own release pipeline, and Launch at Login is a startup setting. None of these is a user-schedulable job capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
